_comment: Grafana alert rules backing up the in-app 'continuous eval task FAILED' Slack alert (tracer/services/eval_tasks/failure_alert.py). Apply each rule with POST /api/v1/provisioning/alert-rules (folderUID filled in at apply time). Rows are one alert per task (per reason for the stalled rule); string columns become labels. Routed by alert_group=eval-tasks to #critical with a 6h repeat (see notification_policy_route).

annotations.description: {{ $labels.reason }} for {{ $values.B.Value }} min. The task still shows as running so the in-app FAILED alert never fires. 'reconcile stopped' = its workflow has not completed a reconcile pass (continuous_cursor not advanced; healthy is ~5 min) — check Temporal workflow eval-task-{{ $labels.task_id }}. 'backlog not draining' = entries pending/running for over 60 min with nothing finishing. Org {{ $labels.org_id }}, project {{ $labels.project }}.

model.rawSql: SELECT t.id::text AS task_id, coalesce(t.name, '(unnamed)') AS task, p.name AS project, coalesce(nullif(o.name, ''), '(no name)') AS org, o.id::text AS org_id, s.reason, s.minutes::float AS minutes FROM tracer_eval_task t JOIN tracer_project p ON p.id = t.project_id JOIN accounts_organization o ON o.id = p.organization_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 'reconcile stopped' AS reason, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - coalesce(t.continuous_cursor, t.start_time, t.created_at)) / 60) AS minutes WHERE coalesce(t.continuous_cursor, t.start_time, t.created_at) < now() - interval '60 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'backlog not draining', round(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(e.created_at)) / 60) FROM tracer_eval_logger e WHERE e.eval_task_id = t.id::text AND e.deleted = false AND e.status IN ('pending', 'running') HAVING min(e.created_at) < now() - interval '60 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tracer_eval_logger c WHERE c.eval_task_id = t.id::text AND c.deleted = false AND c.status IN ('completed', 'errored', 'skipped') AND c.updated_at > now() - interval '60 minutes')) s WHERE t.run_type = 'continuous' AND t.status IN ('pending', 'running') AND t.deleted = false

annotations.summary: Continuous eval task still FAILED after {{ $values.B.Value }}h — {{ $labels.org }}: {{ $labels.task }}
annotations.description: Failed over 6h ago and not resumed; evals for this task are still stopped. Reminds every 6h for 7 days after the failure. Org {{ $labels.org_id }}, project {{ $labels.project }}. Reason: Sentry temporal.workflow_id:eval-task-{{ $labels.task_id }}.

model.rawSql: SELECT t.id::text AS task_id, coalesce(t.name, '(unnamed)') AS task, p.name AS project, coalesce(nullif(o.name, ''), '(no name)') AS org, o.id::text AS org_id, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.end_time) / 3600)::float AS hours_failed FROM tracer_eval_task t JOIN tracer_project p ON p.id = t.project_id JOIN accounts_organization o ON o.id = p.organization_id WHERE t.run_type = 'continuous' AND t.status = 'failed' AND t.deleted = false AND t.end_time < now() - interval '6 hours' AND t.end_time > now() - interval '7 days'

notification_policy_route._comment: Child route added under the root of GET/PUT /api/v1/provisioning/policies. receiver is the existing #critical contact point's name, filled in at apply time.
